title: Mahjong Gakuensai
overview:
"Be sure to invite me to the next school festival!"

The popular strip mahjong game, well received in the arcades, is ported to the Sega Saturn. It arrives with new graphics and free matches added for a full volume of content! Even those who could not reach the end at the game center will be satisfied.

「今度の学園祭　絶対呼んでね！」

アーケード版で好評の人気脱衣麻雀がセガサターンに移植。Newグラフィック、フリー対戦をプラスし充実のボリュームで新登場！ゲームセンターで最後まで行けなかった人も納得の内容です。
